title: Graph tab in the Roadmap page: boxes coloured by status, lines per relation type
description: Add a tab Graph to the Roadmap page in src/ui.js and draw the result of GET /api/roadmap/graph as an SVG. Read this first, it is the usual way to break this file: src/ui.js returns the whole page as one JavaScript template literal, and the browser code sits inside it. Code you add inside must not contain a backtick, must not contain a dollar sign followed by an opening brace, and must not contain a backslash. Build strings with + and single quotes. Lines in this file are very long; make small, exact insertions and run node --check src/ui.js after every change. How the page is built: search src/ui.js for data-roadmap-mode to find the three tab buttons and for roadmapMode to find where a mode is shown, loaded and read from the URL (the deps mode is the closest example: renderRoadmapMode, loadRoadmap, loadRoadmapDeps, renderRoadmapDeps, and the place that accepts mode=deps from the URL). Add the same for a mode called graph. Markup to add next to the deps block: a container with id roadmap-graph that holds a text field with id roadmap-graph-root (root ticket, optional) with an Apply button, a paragraph with id roadmap-graph-status and a div with id roadmap-graph-canvas. Drawing: one box per node, 210 wide and 44 high, at x = 20 + layer * 250 and y = 20 + row * 64. In the box: the key in bold on the first line, the title on the second, cut after 30 characters with an ellipsis; put the full title in an SVG title element. Fill and border by status: done #dcf5e7 and #1f845a, in_progress #dbe9ff and #0c66e4, cancelled #f1f2f4 and #b3b9c4, everything else #ffffff and #8590a2. Text colour #172b4d. Wrap every box in an SVG link with the attribute data-roadmap-ticket set to the node id and call the existing wireRoadmapLinks(host) afterwards, so a click opens the ticket. Lines: for type blocks a solid line with an arrow head (an SVG marker) from the middle of the right side of the blocker to the middle of the left side of the blocked box. For every other type a dashed line without arrow; if the two boxes are in the same column, connect the bottom of the upper box with the top of the lower one, otherwise the right side of the left box with the left side of the right box. Line colour #44546f. SVG width = layers * 250 + 40, height = (highest row + 1) * 64 + 40; put it in a div with overflow-x auto so it scrolls sideways on narrow screens. Above the picture a legend with the four status colours and the two line kinds. In roadmap-graph-status write how many tickets and relations are shown and how many tickets without relations are not shown (hidden); if truncated is true, say so and point at the root field. Outside the happy path: no nodes shows the sentence No relations yet. Link tickets with heist relation add or the Link ticket button. A failed request shows the error message in an element with class error-box, like the other modes do. All texts in English. The data you draw is described by the contract relationGraph: run heist contract show relationGraph and heist type list for the exact fields (nodes with id, key, title, kind, status, layer, row; edges with sourceId, targetId, type; layers; hidden; totalNodes; truncated). This ticket waits for HEIST-51, which builds that function and the route.
why: This is the picture the owner asked for.

A click on a box opens the ticket
The status line names the number of tickets without relations
The other three Roadmap tabs still work

outcome.summary: Graph tab in the Roadmap page: SVG boxes by status, solid arrow lines for blocks, dashed lines for other relations, legend, status line, root filter, error and empty states. Test extended.
